title: Nationwide Treatment Survey of Intracranial Arteriovenous Malformation in China
brief_summary: This register study will collect the treatment information of the intracranial arteriovenous malformation patients in China. We aim to understand the current treatment situation of the disease in China.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All the patients that diagnosed of intracranial AVM by DSA/CT/MRI
* All patients gave written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients refuse to attend the survey
study_population: All the patients that diagnosed of intracranial AVM by DSA/CT/MRI
